pairs: King Nebuchadnezzar made a statue of gold,
sixty cubits high and six cubits wide,
latitudine cubitorum sex, et statuit eam in campo Dura, provinciæ Babylonis.
and he set it up in the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.
Itaque Nabuchodonosor rex misit ad congregandos satrapas,
Then king Nebuchadnezzar sent to gather together the governors,
and all the leaders of the regions,
ut convenirent ad dedicationem statuæ quam erexerat Nabuchodonosor rex.
to come together for the dedication of the statue, which king Nebuchadnezzar had raised.
Then the governors, magistrates and judges,
qui erant in potestatibus constituti, et universi principes regionum, ut convenirent ad dedicationem statuæ,
and all the leaders of the regions were brought together so as to convene for the dedication of the statue,
Stabant autem in conspectu statuæ, quam posuerat Nabuchodonosor rex:
And so they stood before the statue that king Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
“To you it is said, to you peoples,
in hora qua audieritis sonitum tubæ, et fistulæ, et citharæ,
that in the hour when you will hear the sound of the trumpet and the pipe and the lute,
et symphoniæ, et universi generis musicorum,
and of the symphony and every kind of music,
you must fall down and adore the gold statue,
which king Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
Si quis autem non prostratus adoraverit,
But if anyone will not bow down and adore,
eadem hora mittetur in fornacem ignis ardentis.
in the same hour he will be cast into a furnace of burning fire.”

et sciant quia tu es Dominus Deus solus,
